stories.excerpt: It has been decided that former GLORY World Featherweight (-65.0kg) champion Petpanomrung Catmookao (Thailand) will make his return to Muay Thai at the ``Rajadamnern Stadium 81st Anniversary Tournament'' to be held on Saturday, December 26, 2026 at the Rajadamnern Stadium in Thailand. Petch, also known as Pet Panomrung, has defended the GLORY World Featherweight Championship nine times, announced that he would retire from kickboxing and leave GLORY in August 2026, and signed a contract with RWS on November 23rd. It has been decided that his return to Muay Thai, his roots, will be held at the ``Rajadamnern Stadium Birthday Commemoration Tournament'' held every December. stories.originalTitle: 【PANCARSE】ナチン・サットが「アンチ・ドーピング検査」で禁止物質検出。180日間の出場停止＆ファイトマネー5％減額処分＝10月4日『PANCRASE 367』
stories.excerpt: On November 25, PANCRASE announced the results of the "anti-doping test" at "PANCRASE 367" held on October 4, 2026. It has been announced that meldonium, a banned substance, was detected in Natin Sat (IdeaJJ Team/Mongolia), who defeated Kazuki Kasai (Mach Dojo) in the main event's lightweight division by TKO with a left uppercut in the 1st round. Natin Sat suffered carbon monoxide poisoning while on duty on July 23, and was rushed to a medical facility where he was treated with an intravenous drip. ▼Main Event 12 Lightweight 5 minutes 3R ○ Nachin Sat (IdeaJJ/Mongolia) [1R 4 minutes 19 seconds TKO] *Ground punch × Kazuki Kasai (Mach Dojo) *Prohibited substance detected in Nachin Sat This "anti-doping test" is an American test.
stories.originalExcerpt: 2026年10月4日に開催された 『PANCRASE 367』 における「アンチ・ドーピング検査」の結果を11月25日、PANCRASEが発表。メインイベントのライト級で葛西和希（マッハ道場）を1R 左アッパーからのパウンドでTKOに下したナチン・サット（IdeaJJ Team/モンゴル）から禁止物質のメルドニウムが検出されたことを公表した。ナチン・サットは、7月23日の業務中に一酸化炭素中毒となり、医療機関へ緊急搬送され、点滴による治療を受けていたという。 ▼メインイベント12 ライト級 5分3R ○ナチン・サット（IdeaJJ／モンゴル） [1R 4分19秒 TKO] ※グラウンドのパンチ ×葛西和希（マッハ道場） ※ナチン・サットから禁止物質が検出 この「アンチ・ドーピング検査」は、米国の検査
